anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Take, name, sacrifice, roast, eat, leave nothing till morning.
Then the unleavened feast, already out of Egypt.

choices.why: The naming of 1.52: 'this sheep is sacrificed for this one and that one'.

pass_a_gloss: For each of us first takes the sheep, then names, then sacrifices, and so having roasted eats and having eaten leaves nothing of it until morning, and then already having come out of Egypt feasts unleavened things.
pass_b_english: [For] each of us [first] takes [the sheep, then] names it, [then sacrifices] it, and so [having roasted it eats], and having eaten [leaves nothing] of it [until morning, and then keeps the feast of unleavened bread], already having [come out of] Egypt.
source_text: [ἕκ]αστος γὰρ ἡμ[ῶν πρῶτον μὲν λα]μβάνει τ[ὸ πρόβατον, ἔπει]τα ἐπονομ[άζει, εἶτα θύει]ι, καὶ οὕτως [ὀπτήσας ἐσθίει] καὶ φαγὼν [ἕως πρωῒ οὐδὲν ἀ]π’ αὐ[τοῦ καταλείπει, καὶ τότε ἄζυμα ἑορτάζει ἤ]δη τ[ὴ]ν [Αἴ]γυπτ[ον ἐξελη]λυθώς.
